objects: one source-pinned normal-layout card with one single fixed ordinary-mana Kicker ability
the same physical spell and entering permanent
events: select and pay the Kicker total-cost branch
state_reads: current total casting cost and mana sources
prospective destination controller and replacement set
costs: one optional fixed ordinary-mana additional Kicker cost
timing: ordinary casting timing and cost announcement apply
choices: the caster selects the normal or kicked total-cost option
the affected controller orders competing represented replacement effects
hidden_information: cast authority and cost selection are caster-scoped; the stack spell, counters, and battlefield keyword result are public
apnap: ordinary priority applies; replacement choices use the existing affected-player and APNAP coordinators
layers: Flying, First Strike, Haste, and Trample entry grants use the existing identity-pinned layer-6 zone-object journal
replacement_effects: the closed kicked entry is one mandatory self-replacement that creates a nested counter event before commitment
copy: copied, granted, text-changed, and spell-copy Kicker are excluded from the source-pinned contract
control_change: the caster pays Kicker; the prospective permanent controller places counters and controls affected-object replacement choices
zone_change: the paid fact exists only on the current spell object, is captured by immutable replacement and trigger snapshots, and clears under CR 400.7
source_leaves: countered or redirected spells clear the fact on their destination object and create no kicked battlefield result

implementation.component: FixedManaKickerSpec, FixedKickedEntrySpec, source-pinned runtime components, total-cost composition, paid-spell fact, immutable zone snapshots, and canonical entry replacement owners
implementation.supported_slice: One single fixed ordinary-mana Kicker cost linked to fixed positive +1/+1 entry counters and optional Flying, First Strike, Haste, or Trample.

known_blockers: variable, hybrid, Phyrexian, snow, and nonmana Kicker costs
cast and entry triggers conditioned on Kicker
copied, granted, removed, and text-changing Kicker
